note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled at backend/library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (fetch_verse_text("owb-am", ref)), per the founder decision of 2026-11-18 that every Amharic work quotes OWB. Every quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim, replacing the 1962 UBS wording and translator renderings this edition first carried. Citations keep the Amharic library's book names.

A `mined` row is verbatim OWB: a whole verse, a range joined with one space, or the shortest contiguous span of a verse that carries the quoted clause (OWB's own inner quote marks are set as ‹ ›). `self_rendered` marks words OWB does not have (it follows the critical Greek text, so some KJV clauses are absent) or wording adapted to Torrey's application; those, and every prose adjustment made where Torrey argues from a word OWB renders differently, are listed in the re-quote PR.
